description: Checks a landing page for conversion problems. Use it when the user asks how to get more sign-ups, sales or enquiries from a landing page, for example "review https://example.com/ for conversion" or "does my landing page have a clear call to action?". Pass the page address. Returns twelve checks, each with a status, evidence and a fix: the h1 and the sentence under it, the primary call to action and its repeats, whether up to five call-to-action links work, form field count, trust signals, a visible price or next step, the viewport tag, HTML size, render-blocking hints and a contact path. It reads one page, tests a few links, skips what robots.txt disallows for Agent Tools, does not run JavaScript, and returns no page copy, reviews or contact details. It is a checklist, not a conversion forecast, a speed test or a design review. Do not use it for private or local addresses, rankings or traffic.

url.description: Address of one public landing page, for example https://example.com/. A bare domain such as example.com means https. Only public http and https sites on the standard ports are checked.

name: landing_page_check

asOf.description: When the page was read, ISO 8601 UTC.

blockedByRobots.description: True when robots.txt disallows the page for Agent Tools, so it was not requested.

failure.description: Why the page was not reached or read, such as a timeout or a robots.txt disallow for Agent Tools.

finalUrl.description: Address of the page after redirects.

evidence.description: What was found on the page.

fix.description: What to change; absent on a pass.

notes.description: Plain-language caveats to pass on with the result.

notice.description: As-of caveat: what the site sent to Agent Tools at that moment.

reachable.description: False when the page was not reached; failure then says why.

reference.description: Where the checklist topics come from.

requestsMade.description: Requests made, the page and up to five call-to-action links.

source.description: Where the data came from: the website itself.

status.description: HTTP status code of the final page.

title: Check a landing page for conversion
